messages:
Sophia: Heads-up from ACME legal: they insist on SOC2-compliant audit log retention (7y), HIPAA evidence packet, plus confirmation we'll support GDPR data deletion requests touching logs. They want a firm sign-by date next Tue.

Alex: Understood. Can you paste the legal spec they sent or a TL;DR of required artifacts?

Sophia: TL;DR from legal email:
- retention: immutable access logs, 7 years
- export: automated full exports to customer-owned S3, with integrity proofs
- evidence: packaged "audit packet" covering access controls, config changes, and signing/rotation policy
- GDPR: ability to locate and excise POI from logs on request (or prove inability if immutable)
- SLA: retention guarantee in contract or addendum

Luis: Support note: hosted offering currently keeps detailed logs 90d; we have streaming to S3 but not an immutable, signed export flow or POI-redaction tooling.

Rana: Security: 7y immutable storage implies we need tamper-evidence (signed manifests) and KMS policy for signing + clear key rotation/retirement guidance. Also legal will expect chain-of-custody language.

Tom: Eng quick take:
- scheduled dump to customer S3: straightforward
- signed manifest (SHA256 + KMS sig): medium effort (KMS integration + signing service account)
- immutable retention (WORM): depends on storage class + customer S3 config; we can provide tools but customer must enable S3 Object Lock
- selective redaction for GDPR: hard if logs are immutable; options: pseudonymize at write-time or provide redaction transforms on exported copy

Emily: Legal: We can accept an approach where Redwood provides daily signed exports + a standardized audit packet template. If customer needs Redwood-managed immutability warranty for 7y, that's an enterprise-level commitment that requires insurance/legal review.

Alex: Negotiation options for sales to present:
1) Export-only (fast): daily signed exports to customer S3 + audit packet template (ETA: 2 weeks). Customer owns long-term integrity (we provide signed manifests).
2) Export + redaction tooling (mid): same as #1 + redaction-on-export for GDPR requests and an index for targeted retrieval (ETA: 8 weeks, billable).
3) Managed retention (full): Redwood-managed WORM storage, KMS/HSM-backed signing, SLA addendum for 7y guarantee (ETA: 4+ months, legal+finance review, premium pricing).

Sophia: ACME said they'd accept an export-only commitment if we deliver a roadmap to options 2/3 and a clear timeline.

Alex: Proposed minimum acceptance criteria for option 1 (what product/legal will reference):
- daily export to customer S3 with explicit manifest (SHA256 per file + file-level timestamp)
- manifest signed by Redwood service KMS key
- exported records include: request_id, timestamp, actor_id (pseudonymized if required), model_id, route, response_status, latency_ms
- audit packet: architecture diagram, RBAC config snapshot, config change CSV (last 90d), KMS key ID used for signing, manifest verification steps

Luis: Support runbook asks:
- preflight S3 policy checklist (bucket policy, encryption, object lock recommendation)
- retry/redelivery flow (~1-click) for missed exports
- alerting: pager if export fails > 24h

Rana: I'll draft the KMS lifecycle blurb and recommended HSM/KMS perms for inclusion in the packet. Also we should include recommended customer S3 Object Lock setup.

Tom: Sprint spike plan: wire a scheduled exporter + manifest signer for preview cluster. Estimate: 2 infra engineers, 1 platform engineer, 2 weeks for option 1 MVP. Opening infra ticket for KMS role + perms now.

Emily: I'll draft contract/SA addendum language that references "daily signed export and audit packet" and calls out that long-term integrity warranties are only provided under a separate managed-retention agreement.

Alex: Action items (owners & due dates):
- Sophia: create backlog ticket + customer comms (EOD today)
- Tom: infra ticket for KMS signing role + required perms (today)
- Luis: support runbook + S3 policy examples (48h)
- Emily: contract/attachment draft (48h)
- Rana: KMS lifecycle paragraph + Object Lock guidance (48h)
- Product: tag backlog item with: customer:acme, compliance:soc2, hipaa, gdpr, prio:high, target:option1-2w

Sophia: I'll tell ACME we can deliver signed daily exports + audit packet in ~2 weeks and give them an explicit roadmap for redaction/indexing and managed retention. Sound good?

Alex: Yep. Keep execs looped only if they push for Redwood-managed 7y integrity guarantee.

rb-deploy-bot: New preview job rdw-export-421 created for scheduled export testing.

Sophia: noted, will update customer once ticket is filed. :thumbsup:

Tom: infra ticket opened: INFRA-2103 (requesting KMS key alias and service account signing role). Please comment with any additional perms.

Luis: drafting runbook now, will attach S3 bucket policy snippet and sample IAM statements in the ticket.

Emily: contract draft uploaded to legal drive -> link: https://redwood.internal/legal/acme-retention-draft (internal only)

Alex: leaving this thread open until the backlog ticket is triaged in the next planning session.

Sophia: thanks everyone. I'll post the customer update after the ticket is live.

--- end of thread ---

Note: contains customer-sensitive info; internal only.
